name: YEP Projects (Youth Engagement Proposal)
what_you_do: Pitch a youth-led project for Surrey, like an event, public art or a workshop. Funding may be available but is not guaranteed.
who_can_apply: Ages 13 to 18 who live, learn, work or volunteer in Surrey. You lead or take part in the project.
pay_detail: Not a job. Eligible projects may get funding, not guaranteed.
how_to_apply: Fill out the YEP Project Application Form.
notes: Funding requests are reviewed one by one.
